title: R-4: the Kitty studio shell, Home and Chat
description: Applies the accepted studio direction in docs/frontend/KITTY_STUDIO_EXPERIENCE.md to the shell, Home and Chat, recomposing existing surfaces rather than building new ones. Salvages the paused shell work on branch design/kitty-reimagine-20260910 (commits d2f5cb72, 16afc556, 2997fe79) instead of replaying it. The taste judgements in the brief are deliberately not acceptance criteria here; every criterion below is an assertion a test can make, so a worker and a reviewing agent reach the same verdict without anyone looking at a screenshot and having an opinion. Packets run in sequence because they share the same component and test directories. Requires builder-frontend-proof-v1 to have landed: until BFP-04, preflight rejects the frontend gates these packets depend on. Companion docs: docs/packets/R4-00.md through R4-03.md.

packets.title: Shell and theme skeleton on the accepted base
packets.objective: Salvage the still-correct shell behaviour from design/kitty-reimagine-20260910 onto current main and establish the day/night semantic token contract, the grounded navigation, and exactly one persistent Kitty anchor. Fixture state is acceptable here; this packet exists so the direction is visible and wrong before Home and Chat are rebuilt on top of it.
acceptance_criteria: the day theme defines a canvas token and a surface token that differ from each other, and neither is pure white
a night theme block defines every semantic token name the day theme defines, so no surface silently falls back to a day value in night mode
Rail and BottomNav expose the same set of navigation destinations and the same aria-current behaviour as before this packet
exactly one persistent Kitty mascot anchor renders in the shell, asserted by count rather than by inspection
every visible primary control either completes its task or is disabled with one plain-language reason next to it
no raw server error, status code, stack trace, port, environment variable name or file path is the primary message a person reads
nothing reports state it did not measure: no client-only success and no healthy label over a stale source
desktop and iPhone-class widths show no horizontal overflow, clipped dialog or off-screen primary control
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run tests/Rail.test.tsx tests/BottomNav.test.tsx tests/CrayonCat.test.tsx tests/StudioTheme.test.ts --reporter=dot

packets.title: Home becomes the studio front door
packets.objective: Recompose Home so it answers where Jacob was, what needs him, what else is alive, and what Kitty can do now. Reuse the existing projections and the existing onPromptSelect callback; introduce no Home store, no second chat runtime and no new query ownership.
acceptance_criteria: against a sparse fixture, the Calendar/Today, healthy System and generic memory modules are absent from the rendered output rather than present and empty
against a dense fixture, the Continue, Needs You and Open Loops modules all render and each exposes a working primary action
against a fixture supplying no media, no image element renders at all, so no decorative or invented picture can reach a functional card
the Home modules do not all render through one shared wrapper component, asserted over the rendered tree
the Ask Kitty input submits through the existing onPromptSelect callback and creates no second chat runtime or duplicate composer state
every visible primary control either completes its task or is disabled with one plain-language reason next to it
no raw server error, status code, stack trace, port, environment variable name or file path is the primary message a person reads
nothing reports state it did not measure: no client-only success and no healthy label over a stale source
desktop and iPhone-class widths show no horizontal overflow, clipped dialog or off-screen primary control
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run tests/HomeState.test.tsx tests/HomeView.test.tsx tests/HomeStudioComposition.test.tsx --reporter=dot

packets.title: Chat becomes a focused conversation workspace
packets.objective: Make conversation the dominant canvas, with navigation, artifacts, open loops and Builder handoff supporting it rather than competing with it. Keep the existing runtime and transport untouched; add layout and optional contextual disclosure around them.
acceptance_criteria: the conversation region remains the flexible dominant region and the composer stays reachable, asserted over the rendered layout rather than by eye
a context section marked unavailable is not rendered, so an absent source collapses instead of producing an empty or fake card
at narrow widths no permanent second column renders; the same context is reachable through a single disclosure
exactly one Kitty mascot renders in the chat view, not one per message or per card
the existing assistant runtime provider remains the only chat runtime in the tree, asserted by test
every visible primary control either completes its task or is disabled with one plain-language reason next to it
no raw server error, status code, stack trace, port, environment variable name or file path is the primary message a person reads
nothing reports state it did not measure: no client-only success and no healthy label over a stale source
desktop and iPhone-class widths show no horizontal overflow, clipped dialog or off-screen primary control
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run tests/ChatMessage.test.tsx tests/ChatWorkspace.test.tsx tests/RichChatObjects.test.tsx --reporter=dot

packets.title: Prove the whole journey survives navigation and reload
packets.objective: Add browser coverage for the Home to Chat journey across both viewport projects and both themes, so the surfaces proven separately are also proven together. This packet adds coverage; it changes product code only where that coverage exposes a real defect.
acceptance_criteria: a smoke spec walks Home to a resumable context to Chat and back, and the same identities survive the round trip and a reload
the spec runs under both the desktop and the mobile project, because the repository runs every spec under both
the spec covers the day theme and the night theme
the spec asserts no horizontal page overflow at iPhone-class widths
the spec asserts every persistent primary control is at least 44 pixels high
a degraded source renders context and a next useful action rather than an error string
every visible primary control either completes its task or is disabled with one plain-language reason next to it
no raw server error, status code, stack trace, port, environment variable name or file path is the primary message a person reads
nothing reports state it did not measure: no client-only success and no healthy label over a stale source
validation_commands: cd gateway/kitty-chat && npx vitest run tests/HomeStudioComposition.test.tsx tests/ChatWorkspace.test.tsx --reporter=dot
